people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

translations.web: He instructed me and talked with me, and said, Daniel, “I have now come to give you wisdom and understanding.
translations.bsb: He instructed me and spoke with me, saying: “O Daniel, I have come now to give you insight and understanding.
translations.kjv: And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.
translations.asv: And he instructed me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee wisdom and understanding.
